question: Who among the following was famously known as the "The parrot of India"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Amir Khusro** was a prominent** poet, musician, and scholar** who lived in the** 13th century.**
 
• He is often referred to as** "Tuti-e-Hind" **or **"The parrot of India"** due to his exceptional talent and mastery in various fields, including poetry, music, and language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Lata Mangeshkar** was a renowned** Indian playback singer** known for her** melodious voice and contributions to the Hindi film industry**.
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar **was a **virtuoso sitar player** and composer who popularized **Indian classical music worldwide.**
 
• **Kalidas **was a famous** classical Sanskrit poet **and **playwright in ancient India.**
